case.summary: Customer C08299-K1 disputed an online transaction of $30.02 on 2016-12-28. The cardholder first stated they did not make the purchase, but later confirmed the transaction was theirs, creating conflicting evidence. Pattern card_not_present_fraud was identified with exposure of $30.02 and probability 0.45, and case ID C08299-K1 remains undecided because the $30.02 amount appeared 5 times across 3 distinct months under the same product code with a median of 34 days apart, which policy R7 forbids blocking. The card belongs to a shared device component of 2,500 cards, yet transitive device sharing percolates at every threshold tested and carries no weight per policy R6, and known fraud pattern 2 notes that a single unusual online purchase is ambiguous per policy R1 to R4.
